description: README drifts from the engine silently: on 2026-08-11 the README's version string and command table had to be re-synced BY HAND against `VERSION` and `bin/chief` (commit `995263c` 'docs: sync README/ROADMAP/CLAUDE.md with the engine at HEAD'). The engine already enforces version discipline (`test/version-bump.sh`: editing `bin/`/`engine/` must bump `VERSION`) but nothing asserts the DOCS caught up — so the exact drift class recurs. This tasklist adds a hermetic, grep-based doc-sync check asserting (1) the README's stated version equals the `VERSION` file and (2) the README command-reference table covers every `bin/chief` subcommand, wired into `.chief/verify.sh` and CI so the drift blocks a merge instead of waiting for a human audit. Grep/`sed`/`awk` over tracked files only — no network, no agent, hermetic by construction. Scope: `test/` (the check), `.chief/verify.sh` (path-scoped wiring), `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; a `test/`-plus-`.chief/` change alone does not require a `VERSION` bump, but if `bin/`/`engine/` are touched, bump it.

userStories.title: A hermetic doc-sync check script
userStories.description: One script that fails, with a message naming the exact drift, whenever README lags the engine on version or command coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: `test/doc-sync.sh` exists and exits non-zero when the version string README states (the `**vX.Y.Z**` occurrence(s) that claim the current version) differs from the contents of `VERSION`, printing both values

It derives the subcommand roster from `bin/chief`'s command dispatch (the `case "$cmd"` arms — including alias arms like `monitor|watch`, counting an alias group as covered if its primary name is documented) rather than from a hand-maintained list, and exits non-zero naming any subcommand absent from README's command-reference table
Purely grep/sed/awk over tracked files: no network, no agent invocation, no `~/.chief` access; deterministic under `bash 3.2`; `bash -n` + `shellcheck -S error` clean
Self-test evidence: the script passes on the current tree, and demonstrably fails when fed a doctored README (shown via a temp-copy negative check inside the test or its commit message)

userStories.title: Wire the check into verify + CI
userStories.description: Make the gate automatic: the drift class can no longer merge, locally or in CI.
acceptanceCriteria: `.chief/verify.sh` runs `test/doc-sync.sh` when a changed path touches `bin/`, `engine/`, `VERSION`, or `README.md` (same path-scoped pattern the existing subsets use), so a version bump or a CLI surface change without a README sync blocks the merge
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs the check on Ubuntu and macOS alongside the existing suite; `test/all.sh` includes it
The full existing suite (`test/*.sh`) and `shellcheck` stay green; docs (`CLAUDE.md` quality-gates table or `docs/reference/verify-hook.md`) gain one line naming the new gate
